payload.claim: Upgrade case: 2027 guidance (due February 2027) shows adjusted sales and operating profit growing at CER despite the list-price reset; adjusted gross margin stabilises at or above about 80%; US weight-loss share data show Novo holding or regaining ground against Lilly; and FCF conversion is reconciled and moving toward net income. Downgrade case: the 4 November 2026 nine-month report or the 2027 guidance cuts the outlook below the current 0% to -6% range; adjusted gross margin keeps falling below 78%; further large pipeline impairments; semaglutide exclusivity is challenged in the US; the GLP-1 product-liability MDL reaches a material size; or the integrity gate escalates beyond Flag.

prediction.reasoning: The adjusted gross margin is already 78.2% (vs 82.7%) before the roughly 50%/35% US list-price cuts take effect in January 2027, and Lilly's share gains plus generics limit any offset, so the first full year after the reset should land below Novo's own-history p10 of about 80.2%. That is where I part from a price which still assumes owner earnings keep growing at 2.7%/yr on near-historical margins.
